pins.name: SELECT
pins.net: GND on the right mic, +1V8_MIC on the left mic

circuit.role: decoupling, one per microphone, X7R at pin 7
channel select, left (same source as VDD)
level shift 3.3 V brain pad -> 1.8 V clock
circuit.page: needed: p4-5 VIH 0.65 VDD, VDD max 1.98 V

circuit.role: level shift 1.8 V data -> 3.3 V brain pad
series damping at the clock source [mem: usual practice]

logic: 1.8 V only: CLK VIH 0.65 VDD / VIL 0.35 VDD, DATA VOH >= 0.7 VDD at 0.5 mA (p5). Mode is chosen by clock frequency alone: <200 kHz sleep, 400-800 kHz low power, 2.0-3.7 MHz high quality, 4.2-4.8 MHz ultrasonic (p6).

strap: SELECT per microphone (sampled at power-up only)

placement: BOTTOM port: the sound enters through a hole in the PCB under the part; the microphone sits on the side of the board away from the case sound hole.
PCB hole 0.5-1.0 mm dia (not smaller than the 0.375 mm port); case hole and gasket in line with it; response does not depend on board thickness (p18-19).
For ultrasound keep the acoustic path short and wide: a long narrow case channel puts its own resonance in the 20-50 kHz range [mem]; TDK AN-1003 and AN-1124 cover this (p17).
Two microphones spaced as far apart as the case allows for direction finding; keep away from the converter inductors.
notes: Ultrasonic range, read from fig 9 and fig 10 (p11), ultrasonic mode: response is +2 dB at 10 kHz, rises to a resonance peak of about +17 dB near 25-26 kHz, is back to about 0 dB from 35 to 46 kHz and is about -5 dB at 50 kHz (end of the plotted axis). SNR in 5 kHz bands re 80 dB SPL: about 67 dB at 22.5 kHz, 69 at 27.5, 68 at 32.5, 65 at 37.5, 58 at 42.5, 51 at 47.5, 39 at 52.5 kHz. So: usable to about 50 kHz with a calibration curve, falling off fast above 45 kHz.
Ultrasonic mode needs a 4.2-4.8 MHz clock; at 4.8 MHz and decimation 48 the PCM rate is 100 kHz (50 kHz bandwidth).
Sleep is entered by stopping the clock (<200 kHz): 9 uA each, 18 uA for the pair. A load switch on +1V8_MIC brings that to zero.
The data sheet's feature line says '27 Hz to >20 kHz'; low-frequency -3 dB point is 27 Hz (p4).
unverified: Absolute maximum on CLK/DATA was not found in the text; assumed VDD + 0.3 V as for other 1.8 V microphones.
